title: pluchea lycioides
intro: Pluchea lycioides, commonly known as Chinese Skyflower or Wild Cucumber, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and gastrointestinal issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pluchea lycioides include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
